title: Quién, Qué and Cuál in Indirect Questions

sections.content: Use *quién* to report questions about people, *qué* for information or things, and *cuál* when choosing between options or identifying a specific one. The indirect question follows the reporting verb: *Preguntó* quién *vino*. *Quiso* *saber* qué *pasó*. Preguntó cuál *elegiste*.

items.english: She wanted to know what happened.
She asked which one you chose.

sections.content: In an indirect question, keep normal statement word order: *Preguntó* *qué* *pasó*, not a direct-question structure.
